versions.changelog:
Initial release of AgentLayer skill.

- Provides installation and setup instructions for AgentLayer wallet in AI agent environments.
- Supports quick onboarding for OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes platforms.
- Requires Node 24.x, npm, and Python 3.
- Enables local crypto wallet runtime for agents, supporting x402 payments, swaps, and DeFi flows.
- Offers post-install briefings and directs to relevant documentation.
